title: ReviewFindings
description: The review agent's whole answer: its findings, each citing a rule of the slice, a file and a line. Each finding's fields are the engine's machine.Finding.

rule.description: The slice rule the finding concerns, `R-<n>`, as tagged in features/slice.feature.

file.description: The project file, relative to the project folder, for example internal/notes/notes.go.

line.description: The line in that file, counted from 1.

text.description: What is wrong and why, in one or two sentences.

blocking.description: True only when the code breaks the rule and a test of that rule fails at this file.
